slides.title: 🌸 Menstruation & Cycle Tracking — Why It Matters
slides.caption:
🩸 Track Your Period — Record start dates, duration, and flow intensity to understand your cycle better.
📅 Know What’s Coming — Estimate your next period, fertile window, and ovulation days so you can plan ahead.
😊 Understand Your Body — Track moods, symptoms, energy, and changes throughout different phases of your cycle.
📊 Discover Your Patterns — Compare cycle length, period duration, flow, and symptoms across months to spot changes over time.
💕 Keep Your Cycle History Together — Maintain your complete menstrual history in one place, making it easier to understand and discuss with your healthcare provider when needed.

✨ Track. Understand. Prepare. Stay connected with your body.

slides.title: 🩸 Cycle Detail — Day by Day
slides.caption:
🩸 Track Daily Flow — Record light, medium, heavy, or very heavy flow for each period day.
😊 Log Daily Symptoms — Capture how you feel and any symptoms experienced throughout your cycle.
📅 See Your Current Cycle — Quickly know your start date, current cycle day, estimated end date, and days remaining.
🌸 Know Your Ovulation Window — View estimated ovulation start and end dates to understand your current cycle phase.
📊 Build a Detailed Cycle Record — Save day-by-day information to create a useful history of your menstrual patterns over time.

✨ Know what’s happening today, understand your cycle better tomorrow.

slides.title: 🔄 All Cycles — Your Complete Cycle History
slides.caption:
📅 View Every Cycle — Keep all your past and current menstrual cycles organized in one place.
🩸 Review Period Flow — See the recorded flow level for each cycle and compare changes over time.
😊 Remember How You Felt — Review moods and feelings recorded during each period.
📊 Compare Your Cycles — Easily look back at start dates, cycle patterns, and completed cycles.
🌸 Build Your Personal History — Create a long-term menstrual record that helps you understand how your cycle changes month by month.

✨ Every cycle recorded. Every pattern easier to understand.

slides.title: 🌸 Current Cycle — Know What’s Happening Now
slides.caption:
📅 See Your Current Cycle Day — Know exactly where you are in your cycle and how many days are left.
🩸 Track Period Flow Daily — Record your flow for each period day as light, medium, heavy, or very heavy.
🌼 Know Your Ovulation Window — See estimated ovulation start and end dates at a glance.
😊 Log Symptoms & Changes — Record symptoms and how you’re feeling during the current cycle.
💕 Follow Your Cycle Day by Day — Keep your current period, symptoms, flow, and important dates together in one place.

✨ Understand today. Track every change. Know what’s coming next.
